data.name: binesh
data.long_meaning: Bineesh is a Persian and Arabic name which means 'daughter of the wise'. It is derived from the Persian word 'bini', which means 'daughter', and the Persian word 'shah', which means 'king' or 'wise'. This name is often given to a girl whose parents hope that she will grow up to be wise and knowledgeable, just like her wise and noble ancestors.
